abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for another Deoxys and switch it with Deoxys. (Any cards attached to Deoxys, damage counters, Special Condition, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys on the top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poke-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Barrier Attack
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Deoxys by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
